title: Delimiter splitting depends on which other boundaries are enabled (byte fast path ignores grapheme clusters)
property: adding a boundary that cannot match anywhere in the input does not change the conversion result
expected: same result for both; the doc says splitting is by graphemes, where ' '+U+0301 is a single non-space grapheme, so no split occurs (result " \u{301}" -> "_\u{301}" not produced)
actual: [Space] only: "_\u{301}" (split inside the grapheme cluster, byte-level fast path); with an extra irrelevant boundary: " \u{301}" (grapheme path, no split)
evidence: boundary::split has a byte-level fast path when all boundaries are Space/Hyphen/Underscore and a grapheme-cluster path otherwise; the General path comment says it needs graphemes, and Boundary::len docs count graphemes. The same string and same effective delimiters give different words depending on unrelated boundaries.
